   rebase/squash; message names the conflict and its resolution.
2. Resolve `in_process.rs` to main's derivation-aware ac5 rule (proven
   by `cargo test -p hh-cli --test in_process` green; admitted member

   mismatch is a defect to report, never a patched answer).
4. Full verification: `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo build
   --workspace --all-targets`, `cargo test --workspace` (counts cited),
   `bash scripts/check-drift.sh`.
